tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and slide background. Warm, like survey paper; never pure white or pure black.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table header rows and the slider track well, set apart from paper by `rule`, never by shadow.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks, the technical fold, and the range band behind baseline comparisons.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table rules, card borders, chart gridlines, the plat-grid pattern. 1px, never thicker.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, body text, chart axes and the wordmark. Reads on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, axis labels, source lines. 6.3:1 on paper (light), 7.9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tick marks, placeholders, disabled labels and the baseline scenario. Not for running text (3.3:1 light, 4.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: survey
tokens.usage: The brand blue: links, primary buttons, the active slider thumb, the midpoint marker in the wordmark. Text on paper (4.8:1 light, 6.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-survey
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `survey` fill (buttons, chips).

tokens.name: survey-band
tokens.usage: The translucent P10–P90 band behind a range bar; the hover wash on a table row. Never carries text.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: The single accent: section eyebrows, the lot-line tick in slide dividers, highlighted figures at 24px or bold. Never body text in light mode (3.4:1); fine for marks and large type.

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text on a `brass` fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px solid focus ring on every control, offset 2px from the element. 4.8:1 on paper (light), 6.5:1 (dark).

tokens.name: scenario-baseline
tokens.usage: Baseline (no policy change) in every chart and legend. A neutral on purpose: the reforms are the colour, the status quo is not.

tokens.name: scenario-adu
tokens.usage: The ADU scenario, everywhere it appears. Fixed slot 1; validated colour-blind-safe against the other two reform colours in both themes.

tokens.name: scenario-missing-middle
tokens.usage: The Missing middle scenario (green: new homes). Fixed slot 2.

tokens.name: scenario-fees
tokens.usage: The Fee reduction scenario (vermilion: a cost cut). Fixed slot 3.

tokens.name: scenario-combined
tokens.usage: All three reforms together: full ink, the sum of the colours. Always drawn with a label; it is told from Baseline by lightness and from the reforms by hue.

tokens.name: confidence-inside
tokens.usage: Confidence flag: this place sits inside the range of the reformed places the model learned from. Always paired with the filled-circle glyph and the word.

tokens.name: confidence-edge
tokens.usage: Confidence flag: at the edge of the evidence. Paired with the half-filled circle and the word.

tokens.name: confidence-outside
tokens.usage: Confidence flag: outside the evidence; low confidence. Paired with the open circle and the word. Deliberately not a red.

tokens.name: tier-1
tokens.usage: US map, data tier 1 (thinnest data: national sources only). Lightest step of the sequential ramp; 2.1:1 on paper.

tokens.name: tier-2
tokens.usage: US map, data tier 2.

tokens.name: tier-3
tokens.usage: US map, data tier 3.

tokens.name: tier-4
tokens.usage: US map, data tier 4.

tokens.name: tier-5
tokens.usage: US map, data tier 5 (parcel-level data with permits). Darkest step in light mode, lightest in dark: the ramp is re-stepped per theme, not inverted.

tokens.name: tier-none
tokens.usage: US map, a state with no results bundle yet ("bring your own state"). Same value as `rule`.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Slide titles, the app masthead, the report cover. One per page.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: How well does it hold up?
styles.usage: Section headings in the app, report H2.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles, report H3, chart titles.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a title, in `brass` or `ink-muted`. Set text-transform: uppercase in CSS.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every result is a range, never a single number.
styles.usage: App body copy, slide body, table cells. Measure 60–70 characters.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Captions, source lines, slider help text, in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Axis labels, legend text, chart annotations.

styles.name: report-body
styles.sample: Allowing one accessory dwelling unit on every single-family lot would add between 9,000 and 21,000 homes statewide over five years.
styles.usage: Running text in the Model & Assumptions Overview and the Policy Scenario Comparison (print). Headings in those documents stay in `sans`.

styles.name: report-lead
styles.sample: A tool any state can feed its own data into.
styles.usage: Opening paragraph of a report section or a pull quote.

styles.name: figure-large
styles.usage: The headline range on a results card or slide. Always a range, never one number; the midpoint sits in `body` beneath it.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Numbers in tables and tiles. Tabular figures are on by default in Plex Mono.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands, file paths, the commit SHA in the app footer.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tick length, gap between a glyph and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and buttons; gap between legend items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; gap between a label and its control.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; the page side gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a section title and its content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Slide margins; gap between sections in the app.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Report page margins; space above a section title.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, slides, the mark: Lotline is square, like a plat.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips, the slider thumb. The only rounding in the UI.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Chart bars and the range bar ends; just enough to stop anti-aliasing fringe.

shadow.note: Lotline uses borders, not shadows. The one shadow is for a floating tooltip.

tokens.name: shadow-tooltip
tokens.usage: Chart tooltips and the slider value popover only.

stroke.note: Line weights for charts and the wordmark rule.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Gridlines, table rules, card borders, plat grid.

tokens.name: stroke-line
tokens.usage: Line-chart series, the range bar, the funnel outline, the focus ring.

tokens.name: stroke-mark
tokens.usage: The midpoint tick on a range bar; the lot-line rule under a slide title.
